CARD91 Launches UPI Infrastructure

CARD91 has announced the launch of its UPI (Unified Payments Interface) infrastructure. This development signifies the company's entry into providing services that support the UPI payment system. The launch is relevant for the digital payments sector in India, as UPI continues to be a prominent platform for transactions.
